Normal Quake Live.description: Starts Quake Live normally at its own menu. No launcher preset is applied.

Free For All.description: Standard every-player-for-themselves deathmatch with normal pickups.

Instagib FFA.description: Instagib Free For All: railgun/gauntlet rules with one-shot rail kills and no normal item game.

Quad Hog.description: FFA variant built around controlling a special persistent Quad Damage powerup.

Duel.description: Standard 1v1 Duel. The launcher spawns at most one bot.

Team Deathmatch.description: Standard two-team deathmatch with pickups and map control.

Clan Arena.description: Round-based team fighting. Players spawn armed; no mid-round respawn after elimination.

Freeze Tag.description: Team mode where defeated players freeze and teammates can thaw them.

Instagib Freeze Tag.description: Freeze Tag using Instagib railgun rules.

Instagib CTF.description: Capture the Flag with Instagib railgun rules.

1-Flag CTF.description: Both teams fight for one neutral flag and score it at the enemy base.

Harvester.description: Team Arena mode: collect skulls generated by frags and deliver them to the enemy base.

Domination.description: Teams capture and hold domination points to generate score.

Attack & Defend.description: Round-based offense/defense mode built around attacking or protecting the enemy flag.

Red Rover.description: Team conversion mode: a fragged opponent joins the team that killed them.

Infected.description: Infected/horde-style Red Rover derivative included with Quake Live.

Race.description: Movement/time-trial mode on maps that contain Quake Live race checkpoints.

LG Aim Trainer.description: Sustained Lightning Gun tracking: infinite LG, very high health/armor, almost no LG knockback, no pickups. Slash is the first target.

LG Combat Practice.description: LG-only combat transfer practice with 200 health, normal LG knockback, infinite ammo, and no pickups.

Rail Aim Trainer.description: Railgun-only aim practice with infinite ammo and high target durability.

Plasma Tracking Trainer.description: Plasma Gun-only projectile tracking and leading practice with infinite ammo.

Rocket Combat Practice.description: Rocket Launcher-only combat practice with infinite ammo and extra health.

Unholy Trinity.description: Rocket Launcher + Lightning Gun + Railgun. Infinite ammo, no weapon/ammo pickups, fast weapon switching.

Hot Rockets.description: Rocket-only arena: heavy direct/splash damage, fast reload, infinite ammo and reduced interruption from pickups.

Rocket Mayhem.description: Fast rockets, huge splash/knockback, low gravity and faster movement. Deliberately chaotic.

All Guns FFA.description: Spawn fully armed with infinite ammo and fight immediately; no weapon or ammo control required.

Knockout.description: High knockback, low weapon damage and space-map friendly rules. Win by throwing opponents around as much as shooting them.

Turbo Quake.description: Faster movement, stronger air control, bunny-hop physics and near-instant weapon switching.

Glass Cannon.description: Full arsenal, only 50 health and no starting armor. Very fast, punishing fights.

Juggernaut Arena.description: Full arsenal, 400 health + 200 armor, infinite ammo and sustained fights.

Aim Arena.description: Compact all-weapon aim fights: 200 health, 100 armor, full loadout, infinite ammo and no pickups.

Vampire FFA.description: Damage heals the attacker. Keep fighting to stay alive.

Regenerator.description: Health and armor regenerate during combat. Long fights and aggressive recovery.

Plasma Storm.description: Very fast plasma, faster fire rate, expanded splash and infinite ammo.

Rail Frenzy.description: Rail-only, fast reload, lower per-shot damage and high knockback: aim fast rather than wait for one-shot kills.

Excessive Lite.description: A restrained excessive-style preset: faster weapons, stronger projectiles, higher speed and full arsenal.

Weapon Chaos.description: Every launch rolls a weapon, health, movement and weapon modifier package before the match starts.
